look_here_first: Start at the collar and then the seedhead. Indiangrass is a tall warm-season perennial with a conspicuous stiff membranous ligule and auricle-like collar extensions, plus a dense golden-bronze panicle with once-bent twisted awns.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Explicit Hays, Travis, and Williamson records.

best_field_traits: tall perennial bunchgrass from short scaly rhizomes
stiff conspicuous membranous ligule with auricle-like extensions
single once-bent twisted awn about 10–22 mm
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Robust tallgrass Indiangrass with conspicuous ligule/auricle collar and dense golden awned panicle.

comparisons.key_distinctions: S. nutans is the robust tallgrass prairie species; S. elliottii is a more slender eastern sandy-woodland species.
